sequences.advancement_ritual: Extract the strongest emotions that one is most unwilling to abandon before consuming the potion. Inject these emotions back again during this process.
sequences.consumption_backlash: The potion instantly fills their entire body and occupies their soul. Rays of bright sunlight burst out from their body, washing away the remnants of their body's corruption and the heaviness of their soul. Their body becomes purer and clearer, like a holy spirit formed from pure light. Their self-awareness and emotions are being purified and repelled. It wouldn't take long for them to only have the instinct to praise the Sun. Beams of light rose up and enveloped the entire area. The noon descending for a brief moment. At this moment, whoever is responsible to inject their emotions back, no longer let the strong emotions that that person had stripped from the advancer's remain detached from them. They guided them back towards the advancer. One scene after another surfaced in their mind, causing them to experience abnormally complicated emotions. They would once again experience various emotions—their strongest emotions. This would drill deep into them, becoming a foundation of their mind world. It is very sturdy and very reliable, allowing them to withstand the last few rounds of the potion's cleansing forces. Finally, when they open their eyes—it would be pure white.

sequences.advancement_ritual: Find an item with at least an Angel-rank authority and a deep connection to the Sun in mysticism. Bind your most important memory—closely tied to your core justice—to this item, and place it before yourself.
sequences.ritual_essence: The item of the ritual serves as a beacon for Beyonders consuming the Lightseeker potion, providing a mystical connection that would be the last to melt, helping them maintain their direction, clarity of consciousness, and determination to persist through the transformation process.
sequences.consumption_backlash: In an instant, it feels as though they have approached the true sun, their entire body igniting and showing signs of melting. They would not retreat. They would continue running toward the light, the sun, sensed in their core. Their bodies quickly melting like heated metal-first dripping liquid, then softening and flowing toward the ground like water. Their bones melted, his organs melted, his brain melted, and even his spirit and consciousness began to dissipate rapidly. But they would never stop. Supported by the justice deep in their core, they would struggle and wriggle forward, being guided by the faint light of the sun in their blurry consciousness. At that moment, they would seem to return to their most important memory, to what would represent their core justice. Dragging their melted body and soul, fueled by a belief that abandoned everything for the light, they still continue their pursuit with difficulty but unwavering determination. The light grows closer, and their spirit merges with the burning heat, leaving only a sliver of residual consciousness. Finally, they would see a pair of grand double doors, sensing the sun and light he longed for beyond them. Their blurred consciousness collided with the doors, pushing them ajar. A sea of golden light enters their vision, and a sun of intertwining blazing white and gold rises steadily, illuminating all and dispelling the crimson and darkness. They could stop at the entrance, immediately sensing their spirit, soul, and body flowing back together, merging into one. The door they saw quickly becomes illusory, while the sun gradually loses its color and form, revealing its true nature—whatever object they used for the ritual.
